node.statement: Fix universal constants e_it>0, K_disp<infinity, and K_floor<infinity supplied by lem-maincb-improvement-iteration, and set epsilon_max^cb:=e_it/2, delta_max^cb:=min(e_it/2, 1/(2*(1+|K_disp|))), and c_0^cb:=K_floor; then epsilon_max^cb and delta_max^cb are positive and c_0^cb is finite.
